_comment: DEMO FIXTURE. Seed reviews for a few products, written for this project (not real customers). 'Verified purchase' is never stored on a review: it is derived at display time from the viewer's local order history, plus the mock purchaseRecords below for seed reviewers who have no orders in this browser.

reviews.text: Goes on smoothly and the volume is great. I have reordered twice already.
Good product for the price. The brush is a little stiff at first but it softens after a few uses.
Arrived with a dry formula and clumped within a week. Not what I expected from the photos.
The colours are rich and blend really well. The mirror in the lid is a nice touch for travel.
Pretty shades but some of them have a lot of fallout. Okay for everyday use.
Light powder that sets makeup nicely without looking cakey. The canister is sturdy.
Lasts most of the day. I would like a slightly larger size but the quality is good.
Exactly the shade shown. Creamy and comfortable, and it does not dry out my lips.
Great colour payoff. It fades after a few hours of eating and drinking, so I carry it for touch-ups.
Nice glossy finish, but it chipped on day three. Fine for a special occasion.
A classic fresh scent that people keep complimenting. It lasts a full workday.
Light and clean. I wish it lasted a little longer, but it is great for summer.
Strong, long-lasting fragrance and the bottle looks lovely on the shelf.
The cap did not close properly and some of it had leaked by the time it arrived.
